name: l3-gw-up
hypothesis: The other way round: lift a rival group instead of cutting Town. Every Great Work tier III and IV +1 Renown (on top of the package's per-work values) moves winners' largest group from Town to Great Work. Risk: Great Work by 8 sources is already 37-52% at level 1 (55% target), and level-2 tier IV is 54-71%, so this may trade one S1 miss for another. (Per-work deltas, not '*': a '*' patch runs before the package's absolute per-work values and would be overwritten.)
